title: Chapter 122
text: Though there is some debate, it is greatly believed that turning venin heightens one of the dark wielder’s senses. It is this scholar’s belief that the one responsible for the death of King Grethwild developed keener eyesight. For not even the best of His Majesty’s royal fliers could see through the darkness the venin hid within to slay our beloved king. —M AJOR E DVARD T ILLER’S U NACCREDITED S TUDY OF THE V ENIN P ROPERTY OF THE L IBRARY OF C ORDYN
